description: The tracked keywords of your organization with their stats, poll health, matching rules and context, plus `total`. Without arguments: every keyword, newest first. Search the term and context (q), narrow by kind, status (active, muted by a person, paused by the wallet, noisy: paused by the noise brake, capped at its monthly mention cap), platform or group (groupId), order (sort) and page (limit, offset).

groupId.description: Only keywords in any of these groups (grp_...). Repeatable, or comma-separated.

kind.description: Only these kinds: brand, competitor, topic. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

limit.description: Page size, 1 to 500. Omit for every keyword after `offset`.

platform.description: Only keywords tracked on any of these platforms: its term searched there (every platform when its platforms are null), or for appstore and googleplay, an app of that store among its reviewSources. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

items.description: Platform: bluesky, hackernews, github, stackoverflow, devto, reddit, x, youtube, news, linkedin, tiktok, instagram, appstore (App Store reviews), googleplay (Google Play reviews), trustpilot (Trustpilot reviews), googlemaps (Google reviews of a place), rss (RSS and Atom feeds a keyword reads).

q.description: Text to find in the term or in the keyword's context, case-insensitive.

sort.description: newest: created most recently first. oldest: the reverse. term: A to Z. mentions: most matches first. relevant: most relevant matches first. recent: most matches in the last 7 days first. lastMention: newest matched post first, keywords with none last.

status.description: Only keywords in these states: active, muted, paused, capped. Repeatable, or comma-separated.

items.description: active: tracking. muted: switched off by a person. paused: switched off by the wallet for lack of balance. noisy: switched off by the noise brake, mostly irrelevant matches on a workspace running on its welcome credit. capped: at its monthly mention cap until the month turns.

name: list_keywords
title: List keywords
